CrewAI agents in Yui, two ways (INT-15). Over A2A: CrewAI's own server support (crewai 1.15, the a2a extra) is an A2AServerConfig on the agent, whose card comes from agent.to_agent_card(url), and crewai.a2a.utils.task.execute, which runs one A2A task as one CrewAI task. CrewAI joins every text part into the task's description and drops part metadata, so tests/sdk/crewai_agent.py moves the part marked {"yui": "channel_guide"} into the agent's backstory (CrewAI's system prompt) and drops the tap's data part before CrewAI sees the message. AG-UI agents in Yui (INT-21). adapters/agui is a bridge beside the A2A one: any agent served over AG-UI (Microsoft Agent Framework's add_agent_framework_fastapi_endpoint, CopilotKit, Mastra, Pydantic AI, LangGraph's adapter) joins by its URL. Each turn is one run: the bridge POSTs RunAgentInput (threadId = the Yui agent, runId from the turn's rows, the thread's messages, tools, context, state) and folds the SSE events (TEXT_MESSAGE_*, TOOL_CALL_*, TOOL_CALL_RESULT, STATE_SNAPSHOT, RUN_FINISHED with interrupts, RUN_ERROR). AG-UI servers keep nothing between runs, so the bridge keeps the thread on disk (last 60 messages, cut at a person's message) and moves it on only when a run settles, in the same save as the reply. Yui screens are a frontend tool, yui_show(lines): the model calls it, the run ends, the lines reach the phone as a yui fence, and the tap goes back as the tool's result next run (typing instead closes the call and sends the words). The guide rides as a system message by default (--guide tool|context|off; Agent Framework drops context unless A2UI is on). Interrupts go back in resume; state rides along. The Yui side is the shared adapters/a2a/src/relay.ts, not forked; the SSE parser is the A2A one. `pair` runs the agent once first, so a wrong URL fails before the code is spent. Tests: agui.test.ts 18/18 against a scripted AG-UI server replaying Agent Framework's recorded events (tests/fixtures); agui_e2e.py on live Yui with Agent Framework's own AG-UI endpoint (agent-framework-ag-ui 1.4.0, ag-ui-protocol 0.1.22) on local Ollama qwen2.5:7b whose instructions never mention Yui, throwaway account: wrong URL refused, pair, a turn answered once, yui_show called with a pick screen the YL parser reads on the first try, the tap as the tool result answered once, recalled next turn, kill -9 mid-turn answered once after the restart with the same runId, clean stop offline, no token in the log, account deleted, 16/16. Meta Muse Spark in Yui as a model (INT-11). --server meta (or muse) on the model bridge: Meta Model API's base URL (https://api.meta.ai/v1), key from $MODEL_API_KEY at run time (the name Meta's docs use), nothing stored, muse-spark-1.3 unless --model says otherwise, a 32k thread window. Where Meta's API differs from OpenAI's, the client copes: a bad key's 401 invalid_api_key reads as a key problem, 402 billing_error says the balance ran out and does not retry, a 403 for a model the key can't use says that instead of blaming the key, a content policy 400 reads as the safety filter, a context 400 says to lower --context or --max-tokens, 429 waits as long as Retry-After says (the bridge now honors it for any server), a plain 504 gateway_timeout does not retry and says to let it stream, an error event mid-stream (service_overloaded) waits and asks again, a 404 with no body still reads as not found, and the always-empty reasoning_content changes nothing. No request carries stop, n or logit_bias. fake-model.ts --meta replays those shapes; client.test.ts 65/65 (17 new), A2A tests 46/46. No live call to Meta yet: it waits on a Model API key (public preview, US developers).

LangGraph agents in Yui (INT-14). LangGraph's own Agent Server (langgraph dev, and LangSmith deployments; langgraph-api 0.13+, https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/server-a2a) serves every graph over A2A at /a2a/{assistant_id}, so the A2A bridge pairs a graph by its card, /.well-known/agent-card.json?assistant_id=<id>. That server turns each text part into its own message under one id (a second text part replaces the first) and drops part metadata, so the guide sent as a marked text part never reached the graph. For a card listing LangChain's A2A extensions (isLangGraph), the bridge now sends one text part and one data part, {"yui_channel_guide": {version, body}, "yui_events": [taps]}, which LangGraph hands the graph as state keys; every other agent gets the same parts as before. tests/sdk/langgraph_agent.py is a scripted graph (no model) that declares those keys, draws a choose screen only when the guide names it, and answers a tap from its data. a2a_e2e.py --protocol langgraph on live Yui, a throwaway account: pair by the ?assistant_id= card (A2A 1.0), a turn answered once, a screen the YL parser reads, the tap read from yui_events, the thread (contextId = thread_id) holding the guide in state and never as a chat message, clean stop, account deleted, 12/12. The ADK run shares the same runner now. A2A client tests 45/45 (3 new), SDK interop 4/4, scripted e2e 66/66, openai-compat 65/65.
